metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing during two time periods: 1. February 10-25, 2020 2. January 1-20, 2020 They want to know if the levels decreased during the later period compared to the earlier one. For this analysis, I should use: - Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data for NO2 measurements - Geometry around Beijing - Two date ranges as specified - Calculate mean NO2 concentration for each period - Compare the values Data quality considerations: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Validate the results (not NaN, reasonable range for NO2) (C3) For NO2 data from Sentinel-5P: - Collection: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' - Band: 'NO2_column_number_density' - Unit: mol/m² I need to: 1. Define Beijing geometry 2. Get data for both time periods 3. Calculate mean NO2 for each 4. Compare and determine if February decreased compared to January ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const beijing = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Beijing const janPeriod = ['2020-01-01', '2020-01-20']; const febPeriod = ['2020-02-10', '2020-02-25']; // 2. Data Acquisition const janCollection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(janPeriod[0], janPeriod[1]) .filterBounds(beijing) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); const febCollection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(febPeriod[0], febPeriod[1]) .filterBounds(beijing) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes const janSize = janCollection.size().getInfo(); const febSize = febCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan Images: ${janSize}, Feb Images: ${febSize}`); if (janSize === 0 || febSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean composites const janMean = janCollection.mean(); const febMean = febCollection.mean(); // Get pixel counts and mean values const janStats = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: beijing, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const febStats = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: beijing, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const janMeanVal = janStats.get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const janCount = janStats.get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); const febMeanVal = febStats.get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const febCount = febStats.get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan NO2: ${janMeanVal?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${janCount}`); console.log(`Feb NO2: ${febMeanVal?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${febCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (janCount === 0 || febCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (janMeanVal === null || febMeanVal === null || isNaN(janMeanVal) || isNaN(febMeanVal) || janMeanVal < 0 || febMeanVal < 0) { // NO2 should be positive console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if February decreased compared to January const decreasePercent = ((janMeanVal - febMeanVal) / janMeanVal * 100); console.log(`Change: ${decreasePercent.toFixed(1)}%`); if (febMeanVal < janMeanVal) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
